notes:
Account background: Archipelago Synapse Systems is a global ecommerce platform (marketplaces + merchant storefronts). Heavy search and recommender focus; migrating legacy product search to embeddings + reranking.

Main ask: "produce high-quality semantic search & reranking at massive scale (100M-1B vectors) with sub-150ms 95th P99 goals on product search queries and unit query cost <$0.0005. Primary workloads: realtime product search (latency-sensitive), nightly reindexing, reranker for top-100 candidate reordering.

POC summary (Dec 2025 – Feb 2026):
- POC indexed ~600M product + SKU embeddings (dense vector dim 1536).
- Ingest throughput: sustained 1.2M vectors/day on pipeline; peak bulk load 18M/day tested in dedicated run.
- Query workload: 75% low-latency user queries (95th <=120ms target), 25% analytical/batch queries.
- Implementation: ANN layer (FAISS/Milvus) + distilled cross-encoder reranker for top-50. Reranker served as dedicated GPU microservice.
- Performance highlights: batching + async prefix caching reduced CPU overhead and increased throughput 3.8x in test runs.
- Cost observations: baseline using open-encoder (384d) + cross-encoder rerank cost ~0.0012/query; with Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantized models + batching) estimate down to ~0.00042/query.

Security & compliance: needs VPC deployment or private control-plane; full SOC2 + SSO/SAML + KMS integration; legal insists on EU and US data residency options for merchant PII.

Technical risks called out by Archipelago engineers:
- Vector storage costs & snapshot retention (store 12 months of vectors) — storage at 600M vectors is material.
- Cold-start latency for reranker when autoscaled from zero during peak windows.
- Complexity of fallbacks: must degrade gracefully to simpler lexical search under heavy load.

- Unit query cost < $0.0005 without sacrificing relevance.
- VPC/private control plane + KMS + audit logs.
- Ability to pin model versions and fallback to quantized variants.
